quotes.name: Karem Asante
quotes.quote: Man, I sit in those meetings and I hear a lot of talk about numbers, but what I see in my one-on-ones is kids carrying stuff they shouldn't have to. The index slipping? That's just a mirror of what they're bringing in—stress from home, from the block, from not knowing if they'll eat tonight. It's not a stat to me; it's their backpacks getting heavier.
